reviews.text: Effective

They failed to notify me my cat was in acute renal failure in march  it is now sept when when i found out from my cat's daycare when she had suspicions based off his reactions from being transported. Tests were already done but verified with the daycare.

Since arriving in Montreal, we've chosen this clinic for our pets' health (we had two cats and two dogs).

Last year, one of our dogs had a cancerous tumor, and the entire staff at the clinic provided us with the best possible support.

The best veterinarians in Montreal!!!
Excellent team! I've been going there for almost 20 years and they've always taken great care of my cats. Their prices are fair and they truly care about the health of our animals.

They are amazing and so thoughtful.

Thank you!

I’ve been bringing my pups to this clinic for nearly three years, and it is a genuine pleasure every single time. The entire team is consistently respectful, professional, and caring, and I always know my dogs are in the best of hands. I highly recommend the doctors here!
Your support was exceptionally kind, especially in such a difficult situation. Thank you for your dedication and availability.
They're so kind to our furry friends.
The best at everything!!!!

Extremely disappointed with our last visit. We paid almost $100 for the consultation plus the cost of the tests, and the vet couldn't find the problem. Worse, she prescribed medication for my dog ​​without even knowing the cause of the issue.
Very humane staff

Thank you to the entire team for their attentiveness, professionalism, and empathy.
Dedicated staff and excellent customer service.

I quite like this clinic. They are very nice to my grumpy cat and I wish my cat liked me as much as she likes everyone here. Every time I've gone they've been extremely prompt and professional, I would highly recommend them.

When I called to schedule my first appointment on Thursday morning, I unfortunately encountered a condescending and impolite attitude from the receptionist. Her tone lacked professionalism and attentiveness, even though my request was simply for information about a vaccination, not an opportunity to be subjected to a bad mood. This experience did not inspire confidence, and consequently, I would not recommend this clinic.

An incredible vet clinic. From the front desk staff to the veterinarians, they go out of their way to help your animals. It’s small enough that they recognize us, they are kind, efficient and very responsive. 100% recommend.
Excellent service!
Super nice ppl

Aces across the board. They were kind and understanding of our situation, up front about costs and very sweet and patient with our cat (who is not a fan of being picked up even by us).

Heartfelt thanks to the vet, vet techs and staff for helping us understand what was going on with our little fur baby and while we don’t look forward to a vet visit (as it implies something is wrong) we definitely feel like we’re in great hands with these guys.

Thanks again.

I just called about a minor issue with my dog ​​(and I'm pretty stressed, you know). The woman who answered was so kind, gentle, attentive, and even funny! She really made me feel cared for.

*My call was on Thursday, July 31st, around 9:10 am. Give her a promotion or something!! She's a real MVP. 🏆

UPDATE: The experience was really good. I'm often very apprehensive because I had a bad experience at another place. This time, I really felt the staff's love for animals. I felt confident. I didn't feel judged. My dog ​​has an infection, and everything was handled very well. Thank you so much. Seriously, MVP to everyone!

What a wonderful, wonderful vet clinic! We've been going here for 8 years and I could not love the staff more. All the vets and techs are wonderful and clearly love their work, but I have to give a special shout-out to the admin team, who are unfailingly kind, patient and helpful. Anytime I have emailed them with an insurance form or request of any kind, they get back to me within the hour, without fail. It is truly a joy to interact with everyone on this team, and I am grateful to have such great folks looking after the health of my dog.

The entire team at the clinic is very professional and caring. It's a real breath of fresh air compared to other veterinary clinics that often try to upsell you on additional treatments or tests. The team is truly dedicated to your pet's well-being but is also aware of the potentially significant costs involved. I completely trust them to guide me toward the right decision for my animals! A very humane approach!

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the entire clinic team, and especially to Dr. Joëlle Quirion-Sicard, for the empathy, understanding, and professionalism they demonstrated during our emergency call.

We had to call upon their services for our elderly cat, who was in great distress. Despite not being regular clients of the clinic, they welcomed us without an appointment and reassured us, supported us, and cared for our pet with great gentleness and compassion.
The receptionists, like Dr. Quirion-Sicard, demonstrated exceptional listening skills and genuine compassion.
In such a difficult time, their attitude was a great comfort.
I thank them immensely for their dedication and, above all, for maintaining empathy at the heart of their practice. Thank you.
wonderful vet!
The employees are very attentive!
Competent and caring staff offering a wide range of care, more than many other veterinary clinics.
The people at this clinic are so kind. My boyfriend and I moved, but we always go back to this clinic. Why change when we feel confident and well cared for? ☺️
Always very courteous and attentive to the animals (and also to the slightly anxious owners, haha)! It's been over 10 years and I've never thought about changing vets!!

Thank you to the entire clinic team for the impeccable service. I brought my cat in for a denture cleaning and extractions, and the process went very smoothly from start to finish. Communication was excellent, and the team demonstrated great professionalism and punctuality. I feel lucky to have this quality clinic just two minutes from my home. I highly recommend it! 🐈‍⬛
Thank you for always taking such good care of my animals and for taking the time to explain everything to me. Your welcome is excellent and your team is always professional.

6 Spectra dog blankets for dogs weighing 15.1 to 30 kg being sold for $272 when they cost $30 online.

This is highway robbery based on ignorance.

PS: Buy it back from me at that price if you're not thieves. I'd be delighted! You have my email address 🤭
The workers are truly generous and very professional.

I've been taking my cats to this clinic for over 20 years and I'm very satisfied. The vets are competent, friendly, and conscientious. The veterinary technicians and receptionists are also very competent and friendly.
Always good service, always well stocked and smiling staff :)
Integrity, honesty, very humane, approachable and available. Excellent experience for over 20 years.

Claire has his first appointments with the clinic and every time it was pleasant to work with the crew. Friendly, professional and flexible. We enjoyed the services and will continue coming if needed. Thank you team!
Amazing and super friendly staff. The vets, technicians, receptionists are all super sweet. 2 appointments so far and very satisfied

My veterinary practice for the past 15 years. Always attentive, kind, and empathetic, whether it's the veterinarians, technicians, or administrative staff. They listen to your needs and are mindful of your financial constraints, which aren't always easy to consider when making decisions. Thank you to the whole team!
Staff is helpful and friendly, open until 7pm so very helpful for scheduling and buying food after work!
THANKS
